title: Solabia announces strategic partnership with Ethical Naturals Inc.
summary: Solabia strengthens its position in nutraceutical ingredients and expands its presence in the U.S. through a strategic partnership and majority investment in Ethical Naturals Inc

extraction.key_fact: Solabia가 Ethical Naturals Inc.에 과반 투자하며 미국 시장을 넓힌다.
